mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2.0% signals an accommodative monetary policy environment that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines below 2.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI acceleration exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals inflationary pressures that trigger aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDP and housing starts indicates robust consumer and business demand, driving corporate earnings expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST show growth, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate decline below 4.0% signals labor market tightening that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 4.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above 109.0 indicates strong manufacturing output, supporting corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 109.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in retail sales and housing starts indicate accelerating consumer demand, driving revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST rise, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained employment growth rate exceeding 150,000 jobs per month signals labor market overheating, triggering wage inflation and monetary tightening that causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 150,000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate increase above 4.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
